svg.text: Pipeline: each cell = the stage an instruction is in during that cycle
Predicted right: instructions after branch B keep flowing; Execute has work every cycle
Mispredicted: B executes in cycle 5 and finds the guess wrong; W1, W2 are discarded and I3 is fetched from cycle 6
Only 4 stages are drawn, so only 2 cycles are lost. Real CPUs have 15–20 stages from fetch to execute, so one mispredict loses about 15–20 cycles.
